svg.title: Interlayer distance, interlayer slip and stacking energy landscape
svg.desc: Three explanatory panels. The first shows two aligned COF layers with a vertical interlayer distance arrow. The second shows a horizontal interlayer slip arrow between offset layers. The third shows an illustrative two-dimensional relative energy heatmap as a function of interlayer distance and interlayer slip; it is schematic, not calculated ILCOF-1 data.
svg.text: Relative stability across ILD and ILS
Same lateral registry; varied vertical distance
From AA to AB along a selected direction
